title: Published luxury-market figures, Hawaii 2022-2026 (counts, dollar volume, submarkets, records, non-homeowner share)
tier_mapping_note: Hawaii Life bands are $3-5.99M, $6-9.99M, $10M+ -> luxury tier = first two; ultra = $10M+. Hawaii Life gives no $1M or $5M cut: $5M+ comes from List Sotheby's (Oahu single-family $5-10M + $10M+; Oahu condo $5M+) and Maui RPT; $1M+ from Maui RPT, List Sotheby's Oahu condos ($1-2.5M + $2.5M+) and the South Kohala blog. Hawaii Life 'Maui' covers Maui County MLS (map shows Molokai and Lanai sales).

hawaii_life.definition: Full-market MLS (not just Hawaii Life) closed sales; luxury = $3M+, ultra = $10M+; island stats (median, $/sf, DOM, inventory, volume) are single-family; type and price-band splits cover homes, condos and land.

2024_YE.status: not found (smarket product URL for 2024 year-end returns 404; 2024 values below come from YoY references in the 2025 editions)

oahu_2024_sf_3m_dollar_volume_implied.how: 765.3e6 / 1.338 (2025 total and its stated +33.8% YoY); derived, not printed

dollar_volume_caveats: Island 'total of $X million' figures are single-family $3M+: for Maui and Hawaii Island H1 2026 and Oahu 2025 an all-types basis is arithmetically impossible (the band floors alone exceed the total).
Oahu H1 2025 '$610 million' is inconsistent with Oahu full-year 2025 '$765.3 million' (it would leave ~$155M for 70 H2 single-family sales, under $3M each); treat the H1 2025 figure as unreliable.
The 2025 year-end edition prints dollar volume only for Oahu; Maui, Hawaii Island and Kauai 2025 totals are not published there.
conflicts: Kauai 2025 single-family $3M+: report says 67 (+11.7% from 60); Hawaii Life agent blog (2026-04-08) says 66 (+8.2% from 61). Both company-reported.
Hawaii Island 2025 single-family $10M+: 17 in the 2025 YE text; Hawaii Appleseed notes the 2026 midyear 10-year chart implies 23.
Prior-year medians differ by edition (e.g. Oahu H1 2025 median $3.9M in the 2025 midyear vs $3.85M quoted as the 'from' value in 2026 midyear; Hawaii Island $6.8M vs $6.75M).

Oahu_approx._note: bubbles sum to 143 vs 144 stated; one bubble not recovered from the PDF text layer

hawaii_life.submarket_method: Bubble counts on each island's 'A Deeper Look' map page, assigned to the nearest place label by pdftotext -bbox coordinates; kept only where bubbles sum to the island's stated single-family $3M+ total; ambiguous neighbours grouped. Kauai 2025 North Shore split independently confirmed by the Kauai blog (Princeville 11, Kilauea 12, Hanalei 6). Oahu H1 2026 map omitted (bubbles sum to 80 vs 69 stated).
qualitative_buyer_notes_company: 2026 midyear: luxury buyers 'arrive from elsewhere, on their own travel schedules' (p.17-18).
2026 midyear: on Maui 'local buyers are stepping selectively into the $3 million tier where they see dislocation'; softness concentrated in West Maui, Upcountry rose.
2026 midyear: most of 2025's Hawaii Island ultra-luxury closings occurred off-market; fewer than twenty $10M homes publicly listed at any time.
2025 midyear (Oahu): 'international interest, particularly from Japan, remains soft'.

source.note: Hawaii Life agent blog; property types not stated (likely all residential incl. condos/land); not reconciled with MLS.

list_sothebys_oahu.data_basis: HiCentral MLS via ShowingTime; Oahu only; single-family $2M+ in 4 bands, condos $1M+ in 2 bands plus a $5M+ count
list_sothebys_oahu.via: Hawaii Appleseed transcription (luxury_report_counts.csv) of each quarterly page; spot-checked against downloaded Q4 2025, Q1 2026, Q2 2026 pages
gaps: 2026 Q1 page text gives only SF $2-3M (47), SF $3-5M (31) and condo $2.5M+ (13); other Q1 2026 bands (in images) not transcribed.
Condo $5M+ missing for 2024 Q2 and 2024 Q4.

maui_rpt_nonhomeowner_share.what: Maui County recorded conveyances by fiscal year (Jul-Jun) and the HRS 247-2 conveyance-tax schedule actually paid: schedule (2) = condo or single-family home bought by a buyer NOT eligible for the county homeowner exemption ('nonowner' = second home, investor, non-resident, most entities); 'owner' = schedule (1) on an improved residential parcel (buyer eligible for the exemption); 'nonres' = schedule (1) on other property (vacant land, commercial, resort) plus unmatched. 5+ unit building sales excluded. Thresholds on recorded price.
maui_rpt_nonhomeowner_share.derived_by: Hawaii Appleseed (maui_sales_extract.py, commit 48761b8) from County of Maui RPT Sales Data File 2026-09-22 + assessment listing 2026-04-06; shares computed by us (pull/mm_luxury/maui_rpt.py)
maui_rpt_nonhomeowner_share.caveat: Schedule (2) is read from the tax paid (robust); the owner vs nonres split uses 2026 parcel attributes, so for older FYs a then-vacant parcel now built on can be miscounted. Prefer FY2023+.

oahu_stock_not_owner_occupied_by_assesse.derived_by: Hawaii Appleseed (honolulu_entity_share.py) from City & County of Honolulu ASMTPITT/OWNDAT (tax year 2026/2027, pulled 2026-09-25)
oahu_stock_not_owner_occupied_by_assesse.note: Stock (homes by assessed value), not sales; 'owner-occupied' = home exemption on file.

buyer_origin.gap: No 2023-2026 publication found giving buyer origin (state/country) for $1M+/$3M+/$10M+ Hawaii sales. Title Guaranty Buyer Stats are all-price; Hawaii Life gives only qualitative notes.
buyer_origin.tg_reading: Out-of-state buyers' share of dollar volume exceeds their share of sales on every island (e.g. Maui 2025: 26% of sales, 44% of dollars; Hawaii Island 2025: 33% vs 56%), consistent with out-of-state buyers skewing to higher price points; not a luxury-tier figure.
buyer_origin.company_reported: TG = title company (Title Guaranty of Hawaii) compilation of recorded deeds

No published statewide $1M+ or $5M+ count from Hawaii Life; $1M+/$5M+ available only for Maui (RPT), Oahu condos/single-family $5M+ (List Sotheby's), South Kohala ($1M+).
Hawaii Life 2025 year-end dollar volume printed only for Oahu.

source.pdf_text: pdftotext -layout on each Hawaii Life PDF -> PULL/hl_lux_*.txt; map coordinates via pdftotext -bbox -> PULL/bbox_*.html

notes: Company-reported = brokerage publications (Hawaii Life, List Sotheby's, Coldwell Banker). Maui RPT and Oahu stock figures are public-record derived (Hawaii Appleseed processing). Statewide sums are our arithmetic over island figures unless listed under statewide_company_text.
Hawaii Life 'Oahu/Maui/Hawaii Island/Kauai' = MLS island; 'Maui' includes Molokai/Lanai sales shown on its map.
Periods: H1 = Jan 1-Jun 30; YE = calendar year; Maui RPT FY = Jul 1-Jun 30 named for the ending year (FY2026 = Jul 2025-Jun 2026).
No owner names or street addresses recorded; sales identified by estate/building name and neighborhood only.
